d: Long, flowing dusty-rose hair with choppy bangs and a soft texture frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, sharp crimson eyes. The build is slender yet curvaceous, dressed in a black high-neck top under a long white laboratory coat, accented by a black belt with a silver buckle and a visible ID badge clipped to the chest. Two pointed, greyish-white animal ears with black interior detailing protrude from the top of the head.
